agent.problem: This is the only treatment of Jesus sending the Twelve two by two. Because the statement is false, the baker learns only that they were not sent out one at a time; no card ever supplies the actual detail that Jesus sent them in pairs.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.

agent.problem: The preceding story card says only that the Twelve start preaching. It gives no context from which to reason that their message is repentance rather than fasting or sacrifice, so this blank tests wording the baker has not seen.

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: Too many choices rely on discovery rather than informed reasoning. Cards 2, 3, 9, 11, 12 and 14 provide no basis in the earlier cards for reasoning out their answers. That is at least six of the eleven choice cards, so most choices are not informed guesses.

rule.text: A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.
